correctness.rationale: For strict upper triangular 4-by-4 matrices the three product equations reduce to I=(xp,zr,xh+yr) in k[x,y,z,p,h,r] times six free coordinates. The direct ideal identity I=(x,r)∩(p,h,r)∩(x,y,z)∩(z,p,xh+yr) is valid over every field: the first triple intersection is (xp,xh,rx,ry,rz), and reduction modulo I plus P4∩(x,y)=(p,z)(x,y)+(xh+yr) proves the reverse inclusion. All four ideals are prime, including the geometrically integral determinantal quadric, hence geometric reducedness and dimensions 10,9,9,9. The x=0 and x!=0 branches count q^4+3q^3−4q²+q active points, then q^6 free coordinates give q^10+3q^9−4q^8+q^7; n=2,3 are equidimensional. Independently reconstructed the Gröbner intersection over Q and enumerated active solutions over F2,F3,F5, recovering 26,129,905. Existing original scripts including F4 arithmetic and characteristic checks were inspected. The all-field assertion follows from the exact ideal identity, not finite fields.
